proposals.name: Mammuth in decomposizione
proposals.title: Compatto e gobbuto
proposals.canon: Decaying Mammoth / Mammuth in decomposizione: a putrid MAMMOTH, natural elephant-like mammoth anatomy with exactly FOUR heavy legs, ONE flexible TRUNK, TWO curved IVORY TUSKS, TWO small rounded ears, ONE short tail and one head. Large high shoulders/back, coarse irregular remaining fur, weathered decomposed skin and some dry ivory animal bone visible through missing fur, no graphic fresh blood and no human body parts. Its body is still coherent and load-bearing, not a pile of unrelated bones; legs have real joints/feet, tusks grow naturally from the head. It decomposes soil and raises bones from the ground, but do not draw spell effects or many floating bones: subtle old animal bones protruding from soil at the edge only. No horns, wings, armor, saddle, rider or visible magic core.
proposals.direction: A squat powerful short-bodied mammoth with an immense rounded shoulder HUMP, short thick legs and a low blunt head, small ragged ears. TWO medium tusks curve inward then upward, trunk curled under chin without hidingits single tip. Patchy olive-grey decayed hide under short dark umber fur clumps; pale dry ribs subtly visible on one flank. LowerRIGHT in a roofed ROOT-TANGLED forest sinkhole, huge enclosing roots and damp ochre soil, moss green palette. No sky and no cyan/purple magic. Keep all fourfeet distinguishable.

Large high shoulders/back, coarse irregular remaining fur, weathered decomposed skin and some dry ivory animal bone visible through missing fur, no graphic fresh blood and no human body parts. Its body is still coherent and load-bearing, not a pile of unrelated bones; legs have real joints/feet, tusks grow naturally from the head. It decomposes soil and raises bones from the ground, but do not draw spell effects or many floating bones: subtle old animal bones protruding from soil at the edge only. No horns, wings, armor, saddle, rider or visible magic core.
proposals.direction: A very WIDE pear-shaped mammoth with a huge sagging belly, broad short legs, comparatively small domed head and thick cheeks. TWO short robust ivory tusks curl outward in a wide U, trunk raised onlyslightly forward, never a horn. Almost frontal threequarter cautious stance, feet planted wide. Dark aubergine-brown decomposed hide with long ragged charcoal fur and dusty pink-grey scars, no purple glow. LowerRIGHT at a gloomy flooded BURIAL MARSH under thick canopy of dead trees, dark burgundy-brown reeds, smoky mauve lowcontrast centre and grey stillwater. Entire tail visible at one side; no additional limbs.

LowerLEFT in a bleak tundra BURIAL VALLEY between high snow-crusted rockwalls, blue-grey cold soil and dead grass; frame sky out entirely, no moon/sun/stars. Old animal bones only at far loweredge; no icy magic or new powers.

proposals.direction: A huge dome-backed almost round mammoth with a compact high forehead, four stout tapering legs, broad small ears and dense jagged patchwork fur along back, lower flanks nearly hairless. TWO massive tusks curl very HIGH and backward around head sides in open arcs, SINGLE trunk turned sideways away from tusks, small tail. Upright in a turning defensive pose rather than charging, lowerRIGHT. Ochre-rust and dark sepia matted fur, warm grey desiccated skin, subtle dusty lichen but no livingflowers. Enclosed enormous rock CAVERN filled with fossil roots, dry orange-brown earth and coldgrey distantwall, no celestial objects.
